needs.what: a gain_control duration "for as long as <source> remains on the battlefield" (611.2b): the control change ends only when the source leaves the battlefield, and survives the source itself changing controller, so the stolen creature is handed back exactly when Sower of Temptation leaves
needs.why_existing_wont_do: gain_control's CONTROL_DURATIONS are permanent, until_end_of_turn, end_of_your_next_turn and as_long_as_you_control_source; the last also ends when the Sower changes controller (Yuffie's wording), which is a different, weaker card, and `permanent` never hands the creature back
